note: Static self-test fixture for the X-Caravel-Signature webhook HMAC scheme (see WEBHOOKS.md §2 and §5): a fixed {t, method, path, body, secret} tuple with the signature our live signer produces for it, so you can certify your verifier offline. `path` is an illustrative receiver path standing in for the callback URL you register — it is covered by the signature, so run the self-test with this exact value rather than substituting your own. The secret is a self-test value, not a live credential. `data` is abbreviated here to four members: this fixture certifies the signature construction, not the booking shape — for that, see CHANNEL-API.md §5.1.

tamper_test.note: Flip one field inside `data` (`data.revision` 1 → 2), keep the same header/signature, and confirm your verifier REJECTS it. The signature was computed over the ORIGINAL body's exact bytes; any change must invalidate it.
tamper_test.expect: reject — the same header (t + v1 signature) verified against tampered_body must fail
